review_candidates.title: Ingeniero de integración de software
review_candidates.description: ¿Sabías que EDICOM es una de las principales empresas de EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) y facturación electrónica del mundo ? Nuestras soluciones conectan empresas y grandes multinacionales sitas en los cinco continentes e integran sus sistemas de gestión. EDICOM ayuda a digitalizar empresas mediante el desarrollo de soluciones SaaS (Software as a Service) automatizando e integrando el intercambio de datos (EDI) eliminando así, errores de inserción manual y el uso innecesario de papel en todo el mundo. Cuenta con delegaciones en Nueva York, Milán, París, Valencia, Sevilla, Murcia, Ciudad de México, Bogotá, Buenos Aires, Sao Paulo y Casablanca. Nuestras operaciones internacionales se están fortaleciendo en América Central y América del Sur y expandiendo desde nuestra sede en la ciudad de Ciudad de México. Por ello, buscamos hacer crecer nuestro departamento de integración incorporando Software Integrators y así llevar nuestros proyectos de integración SaaS a un nuevo nivel. Funciones Tus responsabilidades: Tu principal desafío será el alcance integración completa de soluciones SaaS EDI, de facturación electrónica y cumplimiento tributario (VAT Compliance, eReporting, etc.). Al situar nuestro servicio de consultoría técnica en el centro, participarás en todas las fases del proyecto de integración: desde la valoración de las tareas recibidas a través de Dirección de Proyectos y coordinadas por la Dirección de Equipos, la discusión de las mismas en los Daily Scrum, la ejecución de las tareas planificadas, formación y soporte al cliente. Acerca de tu rol: Tu primer paso en EDICOM será participar de un curso de especialización de seis semanas aproximadamente a tiempo completo, desde la que te enseñaremos todo sobre SaaS EDI, facturación electrónica y cumplimiento tributario. Una vez tengas acotado el sprint y dispongas de tus tareas definidas, evaluadas y asignadas en tu backlog, podrás gestionar tu tiempo para llegar a lo planificado. Tus tareas serán la automatización de las conversiones de formatos ERP (IDOC, csv, XML, JSON, etc) del emisor a otros formatos estándar (EDIFACT, ODETTE, X12, VDA, Peppol, XML UBL) para su integración según el formato ERP del receptor. Para ello: * Ante necesidades y con cierta experiencia podrás realizar desarrollos a medida (informes), analizarás sus necesidades y te ocuparás de su desarrollo. Asimismo, tomarás y trasladarás los requerimientos de nuevas pantallas al área de I+D (Investigación y Desarrollo) para que desarrolle estas nuevas funcionalidades. * Parametrizarás el SaaS EDI al cliente para la correcta adecuación del proyecto. * Parametrizarás los distintos protocolos de comunicación segura (API, AS2, Web Service, RESTFul, Adaptador Java, SFTP, OFTP2, etc.). para el envío de información entre empresas. Realizarás test de comunicaciones. * Según proyectos y por los requisitos del cliente, programarás en JavaScript para adecuarnos al modelo de integración que necesite el cliente. * Con el tiempo, asesorarás y generarás propuestas de integración adaptadas al formato del cliente. Serás tú quien decidas qué hacer y cuándo dentro del Sprint. * Programarás la transformación entre los distintos formatos de datos entre el ERP del cliente y estándar del destino. * Te ocuparás de la fase de testeo (test funcionales) antes de su puesta en marcha. Capacitarás y darás soporte técnico al cliente. * Llevarás la puesta en producción y fase de estabilización. Te acompañaremos realizando tutorizaciones recurrentes y continuas, cada tres meses durante el primer año, para que te sientas guiado. Requisitos ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Ingeniería en Tecnologías de la Información, Ingeniería en Sistemas Computacionales, Licenciatura en Informática, Informática Administrativa o afines. Se considerará experiencia previa en las tecnologías requeridas y en las responsabilidades definidas, así como recién egresados o candidaturas de estudiantes de últimos años de ingeniería/licenciatura que busquen estabilidad y carrera profesional. Persona con gran capacidad de trabajo y disciplinada. Facilidad de palabra, resolutiva y trato agradable. Buen nivel de inglés (mínimo B2). Se tomará en cuenta boleta de calificaciones y/o posible experiencia profesional. Ventajas del puesto Formarás parte de equipos técnicos internacionales de primer nivel y participarás en proyectos de todo el mundo donde tendrás la oportunidad de hacer que tus idiomas extranjeros sean una herramienta fundamental en tu día a día. Participarás en proyectos internacionales donde podrás llevar tu perfil como consultor técnico a un nivel internacional. Desde un primer momento, podrás proponer e innovar en todas las fases del proyecto de implementación, gracias a las metodologías ágiles y la eficiente comunicación entre departamentos y equipos de la que disfrutamos en EDICOM. Dispondrás de KPIs de productividad que medirán tu valía y proyectarán tu carrera profesional. Quedará a tu alcance una carrera profesional definida y clara desde la que podrás acceder a posiciones como Project Manager, Team Manager, Technical Key Account Manager, etc. Tendrás la confianza y la estabilidad imprescindible para que no te preocupes de nada más que de tu carrera en la compañía. Contrato por tiempo indeterminado. Revisiones salariales cada seis meses durante los dos primeros años acorde a tu rendimiento, crecimiento, actitud, compromiso, habilidades lingüísticas y personales y calidad del trabajo. Posteriormente se realizará cada año.

Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world. At SGS, we have an open corporate and international culture. We offer a dynamic work environment in a leading global company. Our high professional standards and our sustainability approach guarantee you a future-oriented work environment. We invest in our employees for the long term and are committed to supporting your development within the company. Our business principles include: Integrity, Health, Safety & Environment, Quality & Professionalism, Respect, Sustainability, and Leadership. Job Description Main Purpose of Role The Junior Technical Training Specialist –is a crucial role, responsible for, development and delivery of technical training programs for Medical device segment employees. This role is ensuring that Medical device segment employees are supported in acquiring the necessary skills and knowledge for effective conformity assessments in the ever-evolving landscape of medical device regulations. Key Accountabilities Training Course Preparation: Support the Training team in the preparation and maintenance of core training courses related to medical devices, & MDR/IVDR/ISO13485/MDSAP. This includes conversion of raw training material into e-learning modules, leveraging your own technical knowledge and collaborating with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to ensure all content is highly effective and meets defined learning outcomes. Routine administration support to competence and training team including but not limited to training certificates management, enrolments, training records upload into CAPCAP and collaboration with CV reviewers. Peer Reviews and Assessments: Assist the Training team in conducting peer reviews and marking assessments for trainee exercises, such as Technical File mirror review, to ensure understanding of the conformity assessment process. Training Scheduling: Support the Training team in scheduling training sessions (including CPD, webinars, workshops, Team Calibration and peer-review activities) and tracking the progression and qualification status of new trainees. Regulatory Knowledge: Proactively maintain current and in-depth knowledge of relevant medical device regulations, including the EU MDR/IVDR/ISO13485/MDSAP, to ensure all training materials and delivery methods are compliant. Skills & Knowledge Fluent in English Teaching & Mentoring Skills: Ability to effectively impart knowledge and support the learning process. E-learning and F2F Training: Proficiency in both online and face-to-face training methodologies. Communication: Excellent communication skills to convey complex information clearly. Internal Client Focus: Prioritising the needs and expectations of internal stakeholders. Project Management & Teamwork: Ability to manage projects and collaborate within a team environment. Building Relationships: Establishing and maintaining positive relationships with stakeholders Experience Essential Experience in the field of medical devices gained in the IVD/MD industry. Proven experience in progressively training technical skills, preferably within multinational organizations both in online and face to face methodologies. Desirable Setting priorities and working with minimum supervision. Qualifications Bachelor level education, preferably in engineering, science, or research-based subjects or modules. Please send your CV in English Please note that we are only open to candidates that hold a valid work permit in their country of residence. Additional Information Why SGS? Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry. Flexible schedule and hybrid/remote model. SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options. Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents. Benefits platform. Join Us: At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

review_candidates.title: Gestor – MEAL (Cabo Delgado- Chiure) Tempo Inteiro
review_candidates.description: A Save the Children Internacional (SCI), uma organização humanitária sem fins lucrativos com seu enfoque virado ao bem-estar da criança, está a recrutar um (1) Gestor de MEAL baseado(a) em: Cabo Delgado – Chiúre. Propósito do Trabalho O Gestor de MEAL será responsável por assegurar a implementação do Sistema MEAL a nível do projeto EU Stablization nas províncias de Cabo Delgado e Nampula, distritos de Chiúre e Eráti, respectivamente. Isto será feito através da implementação da Estratégia de MEAL, políticas e práticas globais da Save the Children em conformidade com os requisitos do Doador (EU). O titular da posição realizará a monitoria regular da qualidade de implementação do projeto ao nível das comunidades onde este será implementado e utilizará as evidências para informar as decisões do projeto. Tal inclui a garantia de um fluxo de dados adequado, compreensão e uso dos processos e sistemas de recolha regular de dados pela equipa de MEAL e operações, bem como promoção de uma cultura de uso de dados. Deverá igualmente apoiar a elaboração de relatórios sobre o progresso dos indicadores de desempenho, bem como o apoio à equipe do projeto para garantir a qualidade da elaboração e dos relatórios, assegurando disponibilidade de dados e respectivos meios de verificação. Apoiará igualmente o estabelecimento e a implementação de um sistema sólido de prestação de contas baseado na comunidade, através do qual os beneficiários, em especial as crianças, darão feedback e influenciarão a tomada de decisões no projeto. O Gestor de MEAL irá providenciar apoio técnico de MEAL aos projectos ECHO REACH e Radio Aid, nos mesmos distritos de implementação (Chiúre e Eráti). Qualificações Nível Superior em Estatística, Economia, Estudos de desenvolvimento, Antropologia, Sociologia, Ciências sociais ou outro campo relevante, de preferência com Pós-Graduação em M&E ou Gestão de Projectos. Essencial Mínimo de cinco (5) anos de experiência profissional em monitoria e avaliação com ONGs internacionais; Excelente entendimento das diferentes componentes de MEAL e habilidades na liderança do desenvolvimento de sistemas de MEAL; Sólida experiência na coleta de dados por meio de métodos quantitativos e qualitativos; Compreensão dos padrões básicos para garantir a qualidade dos dados e experiência na condução de avaliação de qualidade de dados; Habilidades e experiências na condução e/ou coordenação de estudos e avaliações; Domínio de plataformas eletrónicas de colecta de dados tais como Kobo Collect, ComCare, ODK, etc; Conhecimento de softwares de análise de dados (idealmente SPSS e STATA) e experiência em condução de análise temática de dados qualitativos; Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e apresentação em português e inglês; Comprovada experiência de condução de treinamentos a equipa de programa e parceiros; Capacidades de conduzir workshops de aprendizagem para documentação de boas práticas e lições aprendidas; Familiaridade com mecanismos de feedback baseados na comunidade; Capacidade e vontade de viajar com frequência aos distritos; Aderência aos princípios e políticas da Save the Children. Desejável Experiência de trabalho em projectos de Abordagem Nexus (emergência – desenvolvimento); Experiência de trabalho na província de Cabo Delgado. Candidaturas Os candidatos interessados deverão submeter o Certificado de Habilitações, BI, CV, e a carta de motivação em português/inglês através do link: até ao dia: https://go.mmo.co.mz/6r3s até ao dia: 19 de Outubro de 2026. Aviso Legal A Save the Children Internacional não faz nenhum tipo de cobranças em quaisquer das fases de recrutamento e não procede por via de agentes de recrutamento. Sobre a Empresa “Somos um empregador de oportunidades iguais, encorajamos a candidatura de mulheres. A Save the Children compromete-se a garantir que todos os seus funcionários e programas sejam absolutamente seguros para as crianças”. Aplicamos procedimentos rigorosos para garantir que somente os candidatos adequados para trabalhar com crianças tenham permissão para se juntar à nossa organização e todos os candidatos serão, portanto, sujeitos a este escrutínio.” NB: Somente os candidatos seleccionados serão contactados.

AIC emphasizes quality workmanship, well-coordinated project delivery, strong site safety practices, and practical solutions tailored to each client’s needs. Joining AIC offers exposure to diverse projects and a client-focused environment where technical excellence and safe execution are prioritized. Role Description The General Manager is a full-time, on-site leadership role based in Saudi Arabia, responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations across multiple construction and contracting projects. This role manages project planning, resource allocation, budgeting, and performance tracking to ensure work is delivered on time, within scope, and to quality and safety standards. The General Manager provides strategic direction, leads and mentors project and site teams, and coordinates with clients, suppliers, and subcontractors to maintain strong relationships and resolve issues promptly. The role includes monitoring financial performance, supporting business development activities, enhancing operational processes, and ensuring compliance with local regulations, company policies, and health and safety requirements. Strong project management capabilities covering planning, scheduling, resource management, and risk mitigation in construction or contracting environments. Solid financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, cost control, contract administration, and basic knowledge of procurement practices. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills for engaging clients, consultants, suppliers, and internal teams. Understanding of construction methodologies, building services, and MEP works, with a focus on quality assurance and site safety standards. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced qualifications are a plus. Relevant experience in a senior management or general management role within construction, contracting, or a related sector in the region. Working knowledge of local regulations and standards applicable to construction and contracting in Saudi Arabia; Arabic language skills are beneficial.

review_candidates.title: Founding Engineer – AI-Native Systems
review_candidates.description: Founding Engineer – AI-Native Systems Location: New York City, NY (on-site, 5 days per week) Salary: $150,000–$250,000 base + 0.5–2% equity Working hours: Full-time, approximately 8:00 AM–8:00 PM Relocation: Supported Open positions: 3 About the Company Our client is a seed-stage AI company bringing AI-native systems to the offline economy, starting with consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands. These are the companies responsible for getting products into the hands of consumers through physical and online retailers. The company is building a foundational decision layer that transforms how finance, sales, and operations teams work, combining advanced AI architectures with complex enterprise data. The founding team consists of exceptional mathematics and science competition alumni who have gone on to build and lead teams at prominent technology and financial services companies. The business is backed by leading Silicon Valley investors and experienced industry operators. About the Role As a Founding Engineer, you will be one of the company's first employees, playing a pivotal role in defining its technology, architecture, and engineering culture. You'll design and deliver modern, agent-first systems for enterprise customers, working across the entire technology stack from foundational infrastructure to production-ready AI applications. This is an opportunity for an entrepreneurial engineer who thrives on ownership, complex technical challenges, and building products from the ground up. Key Responsibilities Build foundational infrastructure: Design and develop infrastructure supporting both single-tenant and multi-tenant hosting environments. Solve complex data challenges: Develop systems for extracting, processing, and structuring messy datasets at terabyte scale. Develop AI agent architectures: Create the core building blocks for multi-step, memory-intensive agents, including data access controls and policies. Deliver production systems: Deploy reliable, scalable AI agents for large enterprise customers. Own end-to-end technical delivery: Translate customer requirements into robust, cross-stack technical solutions. Shape the engineering culture: Help establish the technical standards, working practices, and culture of an ambitious founding team. Requirements At least 3 years of experience in backend or full-stack engineering, ideally involving data pipelines, extraction systems, or other complex technical products. Production experience with a server-side programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or Rust, alongside TypeScript. Proven ability to define and deliver cross-stack technical designs for customer-facing products. Strong experience with AI-native development tools and workflows, such as Claude Code, including agentic workflows, loops, and MCPs, or comparable technologies. Experience building payment systems, AI agent architectures, or similarly complex production systems. Excellent debugging skills and strong intuition for diagnosing and resolving production issues. Experience working at a Series B or earlier-stage company, with clear ownership of a product, system, or major technical initiative. US citizenship or permanent residency (green card) is required; visa sponsorship is not available. Ideal Background We're looking for an entrepreneurial engineer who has demonstrated the ability to build, ship, and take ownership in demanding environments. Particularly strong candidates may have: Worked as a founding engineer or early-stage startup builder, with end-to-end responsibility for technical delivery. Experience in forward-deployed engineering, working directly with enterprise customers in traditional or legacy industries. Built data pipelines or extraction systems that directly powered customer-facing products. Progressed quickly into senior or staff-level responsibilities. Studied computer science at a leading university or demonstrated exceptional engineering ability through an alternative path. Previous experience at an early-stage startup is essential. Candidates should be able to demonstrate meaningful ownership and impact within a company at Series B or earlier. This role is best suited to engineers with a track record of building and delivering products, rather than candidates whose experience has been limited to larger, established organisations. Frequent job changes without a compelling track record of company quality or meaningful impact are unlikely to be a fit. Interview Process The selection process is designed to assess technical depth, ownership, and alignment with the founding team's culture. Initial founder interview. Founder-led culture and values interview. Technical deep dive covering a recent project and a short architecture design exercise. Two-day, on-site work trial in New York City. Reference checks. Offer. Why Join? Founding-team ownership: Help shape the technology and culture of an early-stage AI company. Meaningful equity: Participate directly in the company's long-term success. Complex engineering challenges: Build agent-first systems that tackle real-world enterprise problems at scale. Direct customer impact: Deliver technology that transforms finance, sales, and operations in traditional industries. High responsibility: Work across infrastructure, data engineering, AI architecture, and production deployment from day one. If you're an exceptional engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building from first principles, and taking ownership of technology that makes a real-world impact, this is an opportunity to help build something from the ground up.

review_candidates.title: Field Service Engineer (Mandarin Speaker)
review_candidates.description: At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, our over 18.000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large. We are looking for a Field Service Engineer (Mandarin Speaking) to join our team in Indonesia. In this customer-facing role, you will provide technical service and support for our process instrumentation, with a particular focus on supporting our Chinese-speaking customers across Indonesia. Depending on your preference, this position can be based in Surabaya, Jakarta, or Medan. What is the role about? Do you enjoy working hands-on with technology and solving technical challenges directly at customer sites? Are you comfortable communicating in Mandarin and interested in developing your expertise in process instrumentation? As a Field Service Engineer, you will support our customers throughout the lifecycle of their Endress+Hauser instruments. From installation and commissioning to troubleshooting and maintenance, you will help ensure that our customers' instrumentation operates reliably and effectively. Which tasks will you perform? You will: Deliver post-sale services at customer sites, including on-site installation, commissioning, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Endress+Hauser instruments Diagnose technical issues and provide effective solutions to ensure reliable instrument performance and minimize operational disruption Advise customers on preventive maintenance, instrument configuration, and service measures that can improve performance and reliability Provide technical guidance and practical training to customer employees on the correct operation and maintenance of our instruments Complete service reports and other required administrative documentation accurately and on time Collaborate with customers, internal technical teams, and other stakeholders to resolve service requests and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction What do we expect from you? You: Hold a bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline Have hands-on knowledge of process instrumentation and are comfortable working with technical equipment in industrial environments Have knowledge of IT applications, MS Office (proficient user in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SFDC, SAP) Communicate fluently in Mandarin, both spoken and written, enabling you to work effectively with our Chinese-speaking customers Have a good command of English for communication within our international organization Communicate confidently with customers, approach problems systematically, and can work both independently and collaboratively Are proactive, service-oriented, and willing to travel regularly throughout the assigned service area What can you expect from us? The stability and long-term perspective of a successful international family-owned company A collaborative and people-focused culture where your ideas and expertise can make a real impact Opportunities for professional and personal development through a wide range of training and learning programs Close collaboration with experts and colleagues across our global Endress+Hauser network The flexibility and support needed to maintain a healthy work-life balance The opportunity to contribute to meaningful solutions that help customers operate more efficiently, safely, and sustainably How do you apply? To apply, we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by email can unfortunately not be considered due to data privacy considerations. Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding.

review_candidates.title: Executive Heartbeat Lean Leader, Office of Heartbeat
review_candidates.description: Job Description Summary Based in Europe, this executive role leads the enterprise-wide Lean transformation within GE HealthCare’s Office of Heartbeat. It supports the development, deployment, and sustained alignment of the Heartbeat Business System with the company’s 2030 goals. Transformation Leadership: The role champions, coaches, and mentors Lean change; leads Heartbeat Lean Leaders; partners with stakeholders to prioritize improvement opportunities; and co-leads operating reviews, strategy, and priority planning across regions, segments, and functions. Business System Deployment: Responsibilities include supporting bootcamps, coaching, and training while embedding standard work, daily management, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning into business operations. The position also builds Lean capability and manages the organizational change required to sustain these practices. Operational Impact: By analyzing work at the genba, diagnosing challenges, testing improvements, and executing Hoshin Kanri priorities, the role is expected to improve business results and culture, strengthen leadership capability, and contribute to improved EBITDA and Free Cash Flow. Required Profile: Candidates need a bachelor’s degree, at least 15 years of general management or Lean operational leadership experience, and at least 10 years of Lean capability-building experience. The profile also calls for regulated-industry knowledge, experience with AI-enabled tools, global Lean-system deployment, strong facilitation and program-management skills, executive communication, accountability, commercial focus, and change-management expertise, preferably using the ADKAR framework. Job Description Your Challenge The Executive Lean Leader is responsible for supporting the design, adoption, functional leadership, and execution of the enterprise-wide Lean transformation within the Office of Heartbeat at GE HealthCare. As a key member of the Office of Heartbeat team, the Executive Lean Leader contributes to the overall strategy of how we run, change, and act in the business, guided by the principles and processes of the Heartbeat Business System (HBS). This role is critical to ensure the Heartbeat Business System is developed, deployed, and sustained in direct alignment with the company’s 2030 goals. The Executive Lean Leader will lead impactful operating routines and drive execution of critical projects. The role is based in Europe. Your Responsibilities Our Heartbeat Business System is based on Lean thinking and practices and will be an integral part of the way we run, change, and act in our business for the long-term. Each Executive Lean Leader contributes to this progression within the organization. The Executive Lean Leader will focus on selecting, supporting, and assisting with the improvement efforts tied to the Office of Heartbeat’s most critical business processes (e.g., Hoshin Kanri), primarily in the innovation (STO), commercial, integrated supply chain, service, and functional areas. By analyzing work at the genba with our people, diagnosing our challenges, and testing process improvements through an action plan, the Executive Lean Leader will demonstrate continuous improvement and breakthrough performance — ultimately shaping the company culture and brand. The goal is to positively impact results and culture by establishing standards, institutionalizing daily management processes, adopting consistent problem-solving methods, and executing on Hoshin Kanri priorities. As a key member of the Office of Heartbeat team, the Executive Lean Leader will help strengthen and develop the evolving Heartbeat Business System and build people and leader capability in the Heartbeat fundamentals — standard work, daily management system, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning — with a growth mindset that enables culture change. This will require significant change management to embed effectively throughout the organization. Expectations Lean Leadership & Transformation Provide overall Lean leadership at the appropriate Region / Segment / Function level and drive the Lean transformation by serving as a champion, coach, and mentor for change Lead and mentor the Region / Segment / Function teams of Heartbeat Lean Leaders across the organization Partner with global business stakeholders across segments and regions to identify, prioritize, and execute improvement opportunities through Kaizen events and Lean initiatives Co-lead Region / Segment / Function operating rhythms (operating reviews, long-term strategy, priorities planning) in partnership with subject-matter experts and senior leaders Heartbeat Business System Deployment Support the development and activities of the Heartbeat Business System, including bootcamps, leader coaching, and training on Heartbeat fundamentals Install the Heartbeat behaviors and fundamentals into how we run the business: standard work, daily management system, problem solving, kaizen, value stream mapping, and action planning Capability Building Establish a Lean capability program that ensures the application of globally recognized standards for Lean principles and practices, serves as a benchmark for achievement, and provides a common roadmap for continuous improvement and people development Develop capability across the spectrum — from the tactical (deployment and application of principles, concepts, and methods) to the strategic (a transformation that deeply impacts a key value stream) — with effective change management Leadership, Culture, & Change Management Demonstrate and commit to servant leadership and partnership with peers and leaders Align behaviors and practices to our shared Cultural Operating Principles and Heartbeat Behaviors Development and deployment of the Heartbeat Business System will result in improved EBITDA and Free Cash Flow Your Experience BS or BA Degree; Master’s Degree preferred Minimum 15 years of experience in a General Management or Lean/operational leadership role Minimum 10 years of capability building across a variety of Lean practices, including Hoshin Kanri, problem solving, daily management system, standard work, and value stream mapping Working knowledge of business processes within the medical equipment or other regulated industry Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar platforms to accelerate the way work is done, and continuously learning new ways of using emerging technologies Ability to travel up to 40% across Europe and internationally. Desired Characteristics Ideally built and/or designed an organizational management system Ideally developed the playbook for the core processes of an organizational business system Demonstrated successful leadership and proficiency in installing and sustaining a Lean system for a global organization with operations and services teams Deep, hands-on experience with Lean principles and practices; credible with practitioners and executives alike Ability to accurately assess key business metrics and situations from a general manager’s or executive leader’s perspective Excellent time, program, and project management skills — brings order and structure quickly to initiatives and other critical, high-visibility programs Strong facilitation and ability to influence without authority across segments, regions, and functions High attention to detail in daily and visual management without losing the strategic thread Proven ability to hold senior leaders accountable to commitments with candor and respect Growth mindset with hands-on approach; comfortable at the genba and in the boardroom Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive storytelling Experience with Change Management (preferably the ADKAR framework) Deep commercial experience with a focus on the customer and end-user experience Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No
